outcomes: Describe the fundamental materials of the Earth, inclusive of their origins and processes that manipulate them both within the Earth and upon Earth’s surface.

outcomes: Explain the role of plate tectonics on ocean basin formation and destruction, inclusive of processes that operate at mid ocean ridges and deep sea trenches.

Describe the chemical qualities of the marine environment (seawater) ranging from salinity and pH to available gases, noting the controls on such qualities as they span physical and biologic interactions.
Illustrate and explain the origin of coastal landforms and how they define nearshore and shoreline habitats inclusive of currents, sediment transport and deposition, and tidal influences.
Using environmental and taxonomic categorizations, classify different types of marine life with descriptive qualities of organisms and their habitats.
Explain the role of the oceans on a planetary scale, starting with their role within the hydrosphere and as they interact with the geosphere, atmosphere and biosphere.
Apply ecologic principles to marine environments, noting physical, chemical and biologic interactions that define a given ecosystem.
